title: Influence of Vitamin D Deficiency on the Development of Autism
brief_summary: The investigators wish to study the effect of Vitamin D on the development of autism in children. The investigators will also investigate the environmental and genetic influences on the level of Vitamin D in children with autism.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Autistic children
* Healthy children
* Children with ADD

Exclusion Criteria:

* All others
study_population: Children with autism who have presented to the Child Development Institute at the Hillel Yaffe Medical Center and from pediatric neurology community clinics. The control groups include healthy age-matched children and children with Attention Deficit Disorder (ADD) who have presented to the Child Development Institute at the Hillel Yaffe Medical Center and from pediatric neurology community clinics.
